subject: Close cadence proposal & acceptance checkpoints
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
To: Helen Park <helen@greenfieldhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Oct 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Close cadence proposal & acceptance checkpoints

Hi Helen —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation I pulled together a lightweight mutual action plan that maps the acceptance criteria to the procurement and security checkpoints you called out. Attached is v4 of the MAP (spreadsheet) — key points below: 

- Week 0: sandbox access + test dataset load (soft lock)
- Week 1: integration smoke tests, latency/cost sanity checks
- Week 2: acceptance run (business scenarios) + final signoff

Right now the MAP assumes signoff by Oct 18 to meet your go-live window. I know procurement is doing a separate review; if that slips we have two fallback options: (1) a staggered acceptance (soft lock + production gating) or (2) a time-limited pilot with automatic rollback.

Can you confirm whether procurement will be able to complete their checklist by Oct 12? If not, we should agree a rebaseline now so we can reserve Dedicated capacity.

Attachments: [redwood_map_v4.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
[redwood.com]

From: Helen Park <helen@greenfieldhealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Cc: Greenfield Procurement <procurement@greenfieldhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Oct 2029 14:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Close cadence proposal & acceptance checkpoints

Logan —

Appreciate the MAP and the clarity. Two items from procurement/security: 

1) Procurement needs documented retention and deletion controls for the pilot (we need SOC2 evidence and a brief on KMS handling).
2) Legal has a couple of redlines around indemnity in the pilot agreement.

Procurement's internal calendar has a blackout next week so the earliest they can complete their checklist is Oct 26. That effectively pushes our acceptance gate two weeks. If we have a technical workaround (sandbox + scoped data) we can proceed with an interim pilot, but procurement will not approve full production access until they complete reviews.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can do a soft-lock pilot with scoped data and provide the SOC2 extract by EOD next Friday?

—Helen
Helen Park
Director, Platform Integrations — Greenfield Health
helen@greenfieldhealth.com

Date: Fri, 4 Oct 2029 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Close cadence proposal & acceptance checkpoints

Helen —

Thanks for the quick note. Yes, we can run a scoped pilot (soft-lock) and share a SOC2 extract. Proposed approach: 

- Pilot scope: anonymized dataset only, limited token budget, no external connectors
- Security deliverables: SOC2-extract + short KMS summary (attached) by EOD Oct 11
- MAP update: add a conditional acceptance lane that drops to a later full-production date if procurement signoff slips past Oct 22

If procurement needs to set the formal acceptance window to Oct 26, we can do that but would ask for a 30-day extension on Dedicated capacity reservation to avoid capacity churn. We can offer a one-time credit on the first month of Dedicated if that helps bridge procurement's delay.

I attached an updated MAP and a short SOC2 highlights doc. If this sounds reasonable, I'll loop CS to run weekly checkpoints during the pilot.

Attachments: [redwood_map_v4.xlsx (updated), SOC2-highlights.pdf]

Best,
Logan
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Hi Helen —

Grace here from Customer Success — happy to run the weekly evaluation checkpoints and own the pilot acceptance checklist. Proposed cadence: 30-minute sync every Tuesday (standup, blockers, pass/fail criteria) and an end-of-week test report.

To keep things light, we'll provide a short test-run template and a pass/fail rubric for each acceptance scenario. If procurement needs samples of encrypted-at-rest proof or KMS flow diagrams I can pull that with engineering.

Logan, Ben — I can host a working session with Greenfield engineers on Oct 10 to walk through the sandbox and the pass/fail criteria. Helen — does Oct 10 at 11am PT work for you?

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Manager, Customer Success — Redwood Inference

Team —

Quick update from procurement: they cannot complete the full legal/security checklist before Oct 22 due to vendor committee bandwidth. Oct 26 is the earliest firm date they can sign off. Given that, we need to do two things now: 

1) Confirm whether Redwood will accept a rebaseline of the full acceptance gate to Oct 26 and proceed with a scoped soft-lock pilot in the interim.
2) Escalate for approval of the 30-day Dedicated capacity extension and the one-time credit Logan proposed (procurement asks for an explicit credit memo).

We would like a written confirmation (email) that Redwood will: (a) run the pilot under the scoped constraints, (b) hold Dedicated capacity on the proposed terms, and (c) provide the SOC2 extract and KMS summary by Oct 11. If you can confirm by EOD Oct 11 we'll circulate to the vendor committee on Oct 12.

Thanks,
Helen Park
Director, Platform Integrations — Greenfield Health
